verdict.rationale: Canva has an in-product AI (Canva AI), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Canva's own MCP server, which exposes Canva's tools to outside AI assistants. That is the server role and does not show Canva connecting to external MCP servers. Pasting links into Canva AI is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
